K01.drivers: Very wide blocky trunk with no waist taper, short thick legs with knobby knee masses, enormous broad flat feet, oversized hands, arms hanging with a closed gap at the armpit, wide pelvis/crotch set low
limb_cues: huge broad feet with thick ankles
upper arms fused close to trunk

structure.axial_section_shape: broad, deep, near-rectangular block from chest to pelvis, no waist
structure.joint_integration: lumpy, oversized knee and ankle masses; shoulders buried in trunk mass
structure.segment_relations: short legs, long heavy trunk, oversized hands and feet
structure.load_path: weight drops straight through a wide pelvis into columnar legs onto broad splayed feet, slight knee flexion

non_structural_factors.notes: bulk and muscle add to it but proportions and huge feet/knees are the core

K02.drivers: Typical slim adult proportions, normal waist taper, normal limb lengths

structure.axial_section_shape: oval chest tapering to waist, modest hips

K03.drivers: Very narrow shoulders and pelvis with an upper trunk that bulges forward and back in profile (spindle/barrel ribcage), very thin long limbs, arms reaching toward the knee, long fingers, pronounced knee swelling on thin shins
axial_cues: spindle-shaped trunk in profile with anterior chest bulge
limb_cues: arms longer than human, wrists near knee

structure.axial_section_shape: narrow in front, deep spindle/barrel in profile, chest projecting forward
structure.joint_integration: thin limbs with prominent knee and elbow knobs
structure.segment_relations: long arms and hands, slender long legs, narrow trunk
structure.load_path: weight carried through a narrow pelvis down thin legs, slight forward-chest balance

non_structural_factors.notes: thinness contributes but trunk shape and arm length go beyond a thin human

K04.drivers: Same build as K03: spindle trunk bulging in profile, narrow shoulders/pelvis, long thin arms with long hands, knobby knees

structure.axial_section_shape: narrow front, deep spindle profile with anterior chest bulge
structure.joint_integration: slender segments with prominent knee knobs
structure.segment_relations: long arms/hands relative to trunk, long slender legs
structure.load_path: narrow vertical column through thin legs

K05.drivers: Same body type as K01: blocky waistless trunk, short heavy legs with lumpy knees, huge feet, big hands

structure.axial_section_shape: broad deep block with no waist taper
structure.joint_integration: lumpy oversized knees/ankles, shoulders sunk into trunk
structure.segment_relations: short legs, heavy trunk, oversized extremities
structure.load_path: straight down through wide pelvis and columnar legs onto broad feet, slight knee bend

K06.drivers: Ordinary slim-average adult, slight hip width

structure.axial_section_shape: oval chest to defined waist to moderate hips

K07.drivers: Ordinary average adult, slightly broader than K02

K08.drivers: Ordinary adult, somewhat broader shoulders and thighs

structure.axial_section_shape: wider chest tapering to normal waist

K09.drivers: Ordinary adult with slightly longer trunk and shorter legs, slight belly in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: oval chest, mild belly, normal hips
structure.segment_relations: trunk slightly long relative to legs, within human range

K10.drivers: Ordinary adult, moderate build, normal taper

structure.axial_section_shape: oval chest to waist to moderate hips

K11.drivers: Ordinary adult with a moderate belly and fuller trunk in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: chest to rounded belly, reduced waist taper
structure.load_path: vertical, belly slightly forward of line

K12.drivers: Clear protruding belly and deep trunk in profile, waist taper lost, otherwise normal limbs

structure.axial_section_shape: deep rounded trunk with forward belly
structure.load_path: vertical with belly mass forward of pelvis

distinguishing_features: K01/K05 are wide, deep, waistless blocks with short heavy legs, lumpy knees and huge feet and hands; K03/K04 are narrow-shouldered and narrow-hipped with a spindle trunk that bulges in profile, very thin long limbs, long arms and fingers. The two groups are nearly opposite in bulk and proportion and are easy to tell apart without labels.
